svg.title: The trust boundaries of the blueprint
svg.desc: Five boundaries. 1, this repository to every repository made from it, through the blueprint bot and the checks of each repository. 2, the template to Copier on your machine, as data for its sandboxed Jinja. 3, blueprint.py to GitHub, with the login of whoever starts it, reading every answer as untrusted. 4, Renovate to every repository, through pull requests without administration. 5, the dashboard to the public, with every value escaped.
